description: Java class defining configuration for geofencing zone groups, including validation, source checks, and argument conversion.

classes.name: ZoneGroupConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for geofencing zone groups, including validation and source determination methods.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the zone group configuration, checking reserved names, dynamic source configuration, and relation parameters.

methods.name: hasRelationQuerySource
methods.description: Checks if the zone group has a relation query source based on its argument.

methods.name: hasCurrentOwnerSource
methods.description: Checks if the zone group has a current owner source based on its argument.

methods.name: isCfEntitySource
methods.description: Determines if the given EntityId is the source entity for this configuration.

methods.name: isLinkedCfEntitySource
methods.description: Checks if the given EntityId is linked but not the primary source entity.

methods.name: toArgument
methods.description: Converts the configuration into an Argument object for further processing.
